title: Book 7 — Polymnia, Chapter 48
paragraphs: To this Xerxes answered: “You strangest of men, what is the nature of these two things which you say are utterly hostile to me? Is it that our land army is to be faulted in point of numbers, and that the Greek army seems to you likely to be many times larger than ours? Or do you think that our fleet will fall short of theirs? Or even that both will prove true? For if you think our power falls short in these respects, we could gather a still larger force at once.”
